```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, results='hide'}
library(ChAMP)
library(LOLA)
library(data.table)
require(reshape2)

source("../../../Utils/LOLA_two_sided.R")

result_folder = paste("../../../../Results/ClonalCultures/DNAm",format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d"),sep="/")
if (!file.exists(result_folder)) dir.create(result_folder, recursive=T)

data_storage_folder = "../../../../Data/Processed/ClonalCultures/DNAm/"
#options(mc.cores=12)

```


# Analysis

Here I load the list of differentially methylated CpGs (filtered by |logFC|>0.2 and raw p<0.001) between the comparisons and perform LOLA distinguishing between hyper- and hypomethylated CpGs. All CpGs after will be used as the universe.   

```{r}
load("../../../../Data/Processed/ClonalCultures/DNAm/all_results_betas_IM_nonIM_with_healthy_450k_and_EPIC_annotated.RData")
load("../../../../Data/Processed/ClonalCultures/DNAm/myNorm_IM_nonIM_and_healthy_stomach_anno_sorted_450k_and_EPIC.RData")

anno = myNorm_anno_sorted[, c("CHR","MAPINFO")]
```

# Enrichment of DM genes in functional / genomic categories


```{r}
tmp = all_results_betas_annotated[["IMvsNormalAntrum"]]
hyper_cpg_592_594 = subset(tmp, logFC > 0.2 &  adj.P.Val < 0.05)
hyper_genes_592_594 = unique(unlist(strsplit(hyper_cpg_592_594$UCSC_RefGene_Name, ";")))

hypo_cpg_592_594 = subset(tmp, logFC < -0.2 & adj.P.Val < 0.05)
hypo_genes_592_594 = unique(unlist(strsplit(hypo_cpg_592_594$UCSC_RefGene_Name, ";")))
```

```{r, warning=F, message=F}
universe = GRanges(as.character(myNorm_anno_sorted$CHR), IRanges(start = myNorm_anno_sorted$MAPINFO, end = myNorm_anno_sorted$MAPINFO))

all_comparisons = list()
dd = "IM_vs_nonIM_592_594"
all_comparisons[[paste(dd, "hyper", sep="_")]] = merge(hyper_cpg_592_594, anno, by.x="Row.names", by.y=0)
all_comparisons[[paste(dd, "hypo", sep="_")]] = merge(hypo_cpg_592_594, anno, by.x="Row.names", by.y=0)

all_comparisons = all_comparisons[sapply(all_comparisons, function(x) dim(x)[1]) > 0]

GRanges_fun = function(x){
  GRanges(as.character(x$CHR), IRanges(start = x$MAPINFO, end = x$MAPINFO))
}

all_comparisons_GRanges = lapply(all_comparisons, GRanges_fun)
```


```{r}
# taken from Somatic Signatures
ucsc <- function(x) {
    suppressMessages(seqlevelsStyle(x) <- "UCSC") ## '<-' needed
    genome(x) = NA ## avoid mismatches in 'genome' slots for overlaps
    return(x)
}
```


## LOLA extended

We here run the LOLA analysis with "Cgs" as the query data set, "universe" as universe and the LOLA extended data base.

```{r, warning=F, message=F}
dbPath = "../../../../Data/ExtData/LOLA/regions/LOLAExt/hg19"
regionDB = loadRegionDB(dbPath, useCache = T)
```

```{r,  warning=TRUE, message=FALSE}
if(TRUE){
computeLOLA <- function(x) {
   runLOLA(ucsc(x), ucsc(universe), regionDB, cores=12)
}

output_file_prefix = paste(result_folder,"LOLA_Ext_results_IM_vs_nonIM_with_healthy_450k_EPIC", sep="/")

all_results_lola = list()
for (bb in names(all_comparisons_GRanges)) {
     xx = all_comparisons_GRanges[[bb]]
     res = computeLOLA(xx)
     res$p.adj = p.adjust(10^(-res$pValueLog), method="BH")
    
     all_results_lola[[paste(bb,sep="_")]] = res

     write.table(all_results_lola[[bb]], file=paste(output_file_prefix, bb, ".txt", sep="" ), row.names=F , sep="\t", dec=".")
}

save(all_results_lola, file= file.path(data_storage_folder, "LOLA_Ext_results_IM_vs_nonIM_with_healthy_450k_EPIC.Rdata"))

}else{
  load(file.path(data_storage_folder, "LOLA_Ext_results_IM_vs_nonIM_with_healthy_450k_EPIC.Rdata"))
}
```

## LOLA custom Hpy

We here run the LOLA analysis with "Cgs" as the query data set, "universe" as universe and a custom LOLA data base containing genes DE after Hpy infection.

```{r, warning=F, message=F}
dbPath = "../../../../Data/ExtData/LOLA/custom/hg19"
regionDB = loadRegionDB(dbPath, useCache = F)
```

```{r,  warning=TRUE, message=FALSE}

computeLOLA <- function(x) {
   runLOLA(ucsc(x), ucsc(universe), regionDB, cores=12)
}

output_file_prefix = paste(result_folder,"LOLA_custom_Hpy_results_IM_vs_nonIM_with_healthy_450k_EPIC", sep="/")

}else{
```
